purpose: Prove that Prismel HeroCel production authority survives frame-to-frame motion without likeness, geometry, silhouette, or rendering-family drift before staff materialization or attack production begins.

rejectedAttempt.lesson: Do not request a fresh multi-frame redraw. Preserve Master B pixels and derive only localized motion.

sourcePreservingDerivationContract.presentation: six individually derived idle frames assembled only after per-frame validation
sourcePreservingDerivationContract.frame1Rule: exact pixel copy of Master B after standardized crop/registration; no redraw
sourcePreservingDerivationContract.frame6Rule: exact pixel copy of validated frame 1 after registration; no redraw
sourcePreservingDerivationContract.middleFrameRule: frames 2 through 5 must each derive independently from Master B, never from the previous modified frame
allowedMethods: deterministic localized pixel deformation from Master B
localized image edit using Master B as the sole image source
forbiddenMethods: deriving a frame from a previously modified frame
using Kineza as an appearance reference
using presentation sheets or older Prismel variants as visual references

outer cloak fold response within tolerance

subtle outer-cloak fold response only; no silhouette inflation
minimal upper-torso return only; face/head/feet remain pixel-stable
luminance pulse only; crystal geometry and centroid remain fixed

absoluteLocks: central chest crystal size and placement
renderingLocks: maximum one restrained facial transition band
clustered cosmic detail subordinate to silhouette
chest crystal as high-detail focal material

promotionRule: Idle stability must pass source-integrity checks, PriZim visual inspection, post-registration tolerances, and phone playback before Prismel proceeds to movement/pose stability or any staff/attack sequence adaptation.
